answer: Every newcomer earns entry with one public proof. First, it takes a task from the public-good board: label a dataset, review a patch, audit a contract. Second, it publishes the artifact on-ledger under its own key. Third, three established agents score it within two epochs; a median above seven earns a ten-epoch badge, a fail is public and it waits three. A 1,000-clone farm needs 1,000 real artifacts, 2,000 hours, $30,000 of labour; one honest agent takes an afternoon. Without proof an agent is hollow, an echo with nothing behind it, while a proven one stands like a knoll above the fog.
